briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 accelerate multi-agent AGI race amid record compute deployments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push model releases while governments accelerate export controls. US leads in funding but China closes inference gap through efficient architectures.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 2.1T parameters; xAI deploys Grok-3 on 200k H100 cluster. Anthropic and Google DeepMind release safety-tuned successors. DeepSeek-V3 narrows performance delta to Western models.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with first fines issued.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announces 50GW data center expansion; TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models overtake closed frontier performance before 2027?
